satellites.title: One Graph, Different Paths
satellites.evidence: Modern dictionaries distinguish xíng for movement and action from háng for rows and trades. Sound and use matter to reading the graph.

satellites.title: Formation, Not Walking
satellites.evidence: In the five aggregates, 行 functions as a translation associated with saṃskāra (formations). It must not be confused with ordinary 行, to walk or act.
satellites.caveat: A proposed equivalence awaiting verification in an aligned Sanskrit–Chinese source; citation assignment is not verification.
